# SECOM failure-risk model

Synthetic fixture for interface development. The real card is written by the training pipeline.

## Intended use

Rank units by failure risk so engineers can act before final test.

| Metric | Value | 95% CI |
|---|---|---|
| PR-AUC | 0.21 | 0.12 to 0.30 |
